description: Subnets the task ENI may be placed in. Multiple subnets = AZ-spread. Required for awsvpc tasks on Fargate or with create-service.
SG(s) attached to the task ENI. Per-task isolation point — tighter than instance-level SG.
Assign a public IP to the task ENI. Required ENABLED for tasks in public subnets that need to reach the internet without NAT.
Account-wide opt-in for ENI trunking. Increases per-instance awsvpc task density (5-20x). Per-IAM-principal scope.
New ARN format with cluster name embedded. Required for tagging-authorization features.
New ARN format for tasks. Required for tagging.
The ENI attached to an awsvpc task. Returned in DescribeTasks attachments[]. Use to look up the IP, SG, subnet.
Per-container env vars pointing at the task-metadata endpoint. v4 adds /task/stats. Apps should prefer v4 if available.
